verdict.rationale: GitHub confirms multiple official SDKs (TypeScript, Java/Kotlin, Python, Go, Rust), and docs/tour examples are shown across languages, indicating genuine multi-language support rather than a single primary SDK. However, community feedback explicitly flags gaps (e.g. requests for a Go SDK, concerns about Go SDK maturity/idiomaticity), and the evidence pack is overwhelmingly TypeScript-centric for concrete API details (ctx.run, durable timers, error handling), with no side-by-side proof of true feature parity across all listed SDKs. missing for 10: documented feature-parity matrix across SDKs, concrete Python/Go/Java code examples matching the depth of TS docs, and resolution of community concerns about non-TS SDK completeness.
